2. The predecessor of respondent Nos. 1 to 7 instituted O.C. Suit No. 61 of 1965 for declaration that the suit land appertained to his original C.S. khatian No. 27 and that the property recorded in the new Khatian No. 23 in the name of defendant No. 1 was wrongly prepared and that the same is liable to be recorded in his name in the rent roll Khatian No. 22. 

 5. The suit was contested.by defendant No. 1 His case was that the suit land was sold in auction and the landlord purchased it and also took delivery of possession. There after the landlord possessed the land in khas through the defendant as bargadar who subsequently took settlement of the said land from the landlord in 1355 B.S. Since then he has been in possession. The rent roll Khatian No. 23 has been correctly prepared.
